nameJa: クリームの透過レイヤー
conceptNote: 動画の斜線がチャットの背後まで続き、全画面の中へ重なる関係を示す。
prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: premium Chrome Web Store discovery tile, one complete image. Generate landscape 11:7 composition, target 1760 x 1120. Absolutely NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO PSEUDO-TEXT. Explain a browser extension that overlays live chat inside fullscreen video. Refined modern flat graphic design, warm cream background #f5f0e7, red wireframe geometry, charcoal details, generous spacing. One large widescreen video rectangle occupies 82% of canvas width and 70% height. FOUR red fullscreen corner brackets are around the ENTIRE rectangle: top-left, bottom-left, top-right and bottom-right at far outer right beyond the chat. Within the video rectangle: two broad elegant diagonal pale coral and dusty mauve geometric bands, not a landscape, and a clear red play triangle at about 36% horizontal. A compact semi-translucent white chat panel floats INSIDE the video, middle-right, about 26% of video width, 62% of video height. The diagonal video bands subtly remain visible under its transparent surface to communicate overlay. It has four restrained rows of tiny avatar circles and simple horizontal message strokes, wide comfortable row spacing, blank rounded composer bar and small send triangle at bottom. The rows are abstract symbols, no characters. The chat panel is inset from outer right border; leave video margin between chat and fullscreen marks. Editorial sophistication, crisp vector-like edges, controlled line weights, beautiful empty space, visually readable at 440x280. No physical device, no browser toolbar, no labels, no realism, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows, no scenery, no mountains, no sun, no stars, no logos, no watermark. Diagram only, not a plain app icon.
